mapper.insert:
SELECT APP_ERROR_LOG_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO NYEHMS_APP_ERROR_LOG ( APP_LOG_ID, APP_LOG_DATE, APP_USER_ID, APP_SESSION_ID, APP_LOG_MSG, APP_LOG_ERROR, APP_LOG_STACKTRACE ) VALUES ( #{appLogId}, #{p_log_date}, #{p_user_id}, #{p_session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{p_log_message:CLOB}, #{p_log_error:CLOB}, #{p_log_stacktrace:CLOB} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NYEHMS_WORKER_PERMISSION_VW WHERE WORKER_ID=#{workeId} AND MODULE_NAME=#{moduleName} AND PERMISSION_ID=#{permissionId}

select DISTINCT PERMISSION_ID, PERMISSION from NYEHMS_WORKER_PERMISSION_VW where WORKER_ID = #{workerId}
AND WORKER_REGION_ID = #{workerRegionId}

SELECT FIRST_NAME USERFIRSTNAME, LAST_NAME USERLASTNAME, FIRST_NAME || ' ' ||LAST_NAME USERNAME, WORKER_ID WORKERID, LEGACY_UID USERID, FULL_NAME USERFULLNAME, LAST_LOGIN_DATE LASTLOGIN, EMAIL_ADDR emailAddress FROM NYEHMS_USERS_VW WHERE UPPER(LEGACY_UID)=UPPER(#{userId}) AND (END_DATE IS NULL OR END_DATE > SYSDATE)

choose.when: SELECT DISTINCT COUNTY AS FIELDNAME, COUNTY_FIPS_CD AS COUNTYFIPSCD FROM NYEHMS_COUNTY_REFERENCE WHERE UPPER(CITY) LIKE UPPER(#{city})||'%' AND STATE_CD = 'NY' AND ZIP_CD LIKE #{zip}||'%' ORDER BY FIELDNAME
SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(${fieldName}) AS FIELDNAME FROM NYEHMS_COUNTY_REFERENCE WHERE UPPER(CITY) LIKE UPPER(#{city})||'%' AND STATE_CD != 'NY' AND ZIP_CD LIKE #{zip}||'%' ORDER BY FIELDNAME
choose.otherwise:
SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(${fieldName}) AS FIELDNAME FROM NYEHMS_COUNTY_REFERENCE WHERE UPPER(CITY) LIKE UPPER(#{city})||'%' AND UPPER(STATE_CD) LIKE UPPER(#{state})||'%' AND ZIP_CD LIKE #{zip}||'%'
AND UPPER(COUNTY) LIKE UPPER(#{county})||'%'
ORDER BY FIELDNAME

mapper.select:
select count(ZIP_CD) from NYEHMS_COUNTY_REFERENCE where UPPER(CITY) = UPPER(#{city}) and UPPER(STATE_CD) = UPPER(#{state}) and ZIP_CD = UPPER(#{zip})
AND COUNTY_FIPS_CD = UPPER(#{county})
SELECT DISTINCT STATE_CD CODE, STATE_CD VALUE FROM NYEHMS_COUNTY_REFERENCE order by STATE_CD
SELECT DISTINCT COUNTRY_CODE CODE, COUNTRY_DESC VALUE FROM CODED_COUNTRY order by VALUE

select COUNTYNAME,COUNTYFIPSCD from (SELECT DECODE (COUNTY_FIPS_CODE, 998,100, 999, 101, ROWNUM) AS rowNumber, COUNTY_NAME COUNTYNAME, COUNTY_FIPS_CODE COUNTYFIPSCD FROM CODED_COUNTY) order by rowNumber
select LAST_CONF_SECURITY_TRNG_DATE from NYEHMS_USERS_VW where LEGACY_UID = #{userId} and (END_DATE is NULL OR END_DATE > SYSDATE)
mapper.insert: UPDATE NYEHMS_USERS set LAST_LOGIN_DATE = SYSDATE where WORKER_ID = #{workerId}
mapper.select: { ? = call pkg_standardization.fn_improve_std_address(?) }
{call Pkg_trk_common.pr_set_client_session()}
${tableName}
select soundex(#{name}) from dual
select PS_MSG_TYPE, PS_MSG_TYPE_DESCRIPTION, DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE from coded_ps_msg_type where END_DATE is null order by SORT_ORDER asc
SELECT PKG_CONSOLIDATION.FN_GIVE_CURRENT_STATENO (#{_stateno}) CURRENT_STATENO from DUAL
mapper.insert: insert into USER_ACCESS_AUDIT_LOG(WORKER_ID, AGREED_DATE) values(#{WORKER_ID, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: select NVL(COUNTY_FIPS_CD, '999') COUNTY_FIPS_CD, STATE_CD, CITY from NYEHMS_COUNTY_REFERENCE where ZIP_CD = #{_zip} and NUM_CITY = 1 and rownum < 2
select count(*) from NYEHMS_EHARS_STATENO_MAP where rownum < 2
select count(*) from EHARS_PERSON_NYC where rownum < 2
select ZIP_CD, CITY, COUNTY, COUNTY_FIPS_CD, STATE_CD from NYEHMS_COUNTY_REFERENCE where NUM_CITY = 1
select LISTAGG(ehars_Stateno, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY nyehms_stateno) EHARS_STATENO from ( select nyehms_stateno, ehars_Stateno from nyehms_ehars_stateno_map where nyehms_Stateno = #{stateno})

select LISTAGG(ehars_Stateno, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY nyehms_stateno) EHARS_STATENO, LISTAGG(CITYNO, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY nyehms_stateno) CITYNO from ( select CITYNO, EHARS_STATENO, NYEHMS_STATENO from EHARS_PERSON_NYC where NYEHMS_STATENO = #{stateno})
select LEGACY_UID USER_ID, FULL_NAME, WORKER_ID from NYEHMS_USERS_VW where (END_DATE is NULL or END_DATE > SYSDATE) and LEGACY_UID is NOT null and IS_LOCKED != 'Y' order by FULL_NAME asc
select ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE, ACTIVITY_TYPE_DESCRIPTION from CODED_ACTIVITY_TYPE where ACTIVITY_CATEGORY_CODE ='ACLS' and END_DATE is null and NEED_ACRF = 'M'

SELECT file_type FROM coded_file_frequency_reminder WHERE Trunc(sysdate) + (select PARAMTER_VALUE from lab_scheduler_parameters where paramter_name = 'FILE_NOTIFICATION_DAYS') = To_Date(receive_months, 'MM')

SELECT EMAIL_ADDR, initcap(first_name) first_name, pkg_trk_common.fn_get_fullname (last_name, first_name, middle_name, NULL) userName, to_char(ROUND (SYSDATE - last_login_date)) daysSinceLoggedIn, initcap(trim(TO_CHAR (SYSDATE + (90 - ROUND (SYSDATE - last_login_date)), 'DAY'))) weekname, trim(TO_CHAR (SYSDATE + (90 - ROUND (SYSDATE - last_login_date)), 'DD')) day, initcap(trim(TO_CHAR (SYSDATE + (90 - ROUND (SYSDATE - last_login_date)), 'MONTH'))) month FROM nyehms_users WHERE REGEXP_LIKE (user_type, 'APP') AND NVL (is_locked, 'N') = 'N' AND end_date IS NULL AND ROUND (SYSDATE - last_login_date) > 90 - 15

SELECT EMAIL_ADDR, initcap(first_name) first_name, pkg_trk_common.fn_get_fullname (last_name, first_name, middle_name, NULL) userName, LAST_CONF_SECURITY_TRNG_DATE, to_char(ROUND(ADD_MONTHS(LAST_CONF_SECURITY_TRNG_DATE, 12)-sysdate)) daysToRenew, initcap(trim(TO_CHAR (ADD_MONTHS(LAST_CONF_SECURITY_TRNG_DATE, 12), 'DAY'))) weekname, trim(TO_CHAR (ADD_MONTHS(LAST_CONF_SECURITY_TRNG_DATE, 12), 'DD')) day, initcap(trim(TO_CHAR (ADD_MONTHS(LAST_CONF_SECURITY_TRNG_DATE, 12), 'MONTH'))) month, initcap(trim(TO_CHAR (ADD_MONTHS(LAST_CONF_SECURITY_TRNG_DATE, 12), 'YYYY'))) year FROM nyehms_users WHERE REGEXP_LIKE (user_type, 'APP|BACKEND') AND end_date IS NULL AND ROUND(ADD_MONTHS(LAST_CONF_SECURITY_TRNG_DATE, 12)-sysdate) < 30
select COUNTY_CD, county_name from coded_county where COUNTY_CD is not null
select get_crypto_card_image from dual
